events.title: Hugh Capet Crowned King of France
events.description: Hugh Capet was crowned King of France. He became the first monarch of the Capetian dynasty.
events.significance: His line ruled France in various branches for centuries. The monarchy lasted until the French Revolution.

events.title: Samuel de Champlain Founds Quebec City
events.description: French explorer Samuel de Champlain founded a settlement on the St. Lawrence River. It became Quebec City.
events.significance: Quebec became the cornerstone of New France. It is one of the oldest European-founded cities in North America.

events.title: Pickett's Charge Ends the Battle of Gettysburg
events.description: On the third day of Gettysburg, Confederate forces made a massive assault on the Union center at Cemetery Ridge. The assault, known as Pickett's Charge, failed.
events.significance: The battle is widely seen as a turning point of the American Civil War. It ended Robert E. Lee's invasion of the North.

events.title: Idaho Becomes the 43rd U.S. State
events.description: Idaho was admitted to the Union as the 43rd state.
events.significance: Idaho's admission continued the settlement and political incorporation of the American West in the late 19th century.
